problem: a,b,c,d = construct_isquare(), e = construct_shift(a,d,c), f = construct_lc_tangent(a,c)
proof:
Solution:
1. Square(a,b,c,d) => Length_a_d - Length_c_d & Angle_a_d_b - Angle_c_a_d & Angle_a_c_d - Angle_b_d_c & Perpendicular(a,c,b,d)
2. Length_a_d - Length_c_d & Length_a_e - Length_c_d => Length_a_d - Length_a_e
3. Parallel(a,c,d,e) & Parallel(a,e,c,d) => Parallelogram(a,c,d,e)
4. Parallelogram(a,c,d,e) => Angle_a_c_d - Angle_a_e_d
5. Perpendicular(a,c,a,f) => Angle_c_a_f - pi/2
6. Perpendicular(a,c,a,f) & Parallel(a,c,d,e) => Perpendicular(a,f,d,e)
7. Perpendicular(a,f,d,e) => Angle_a_e_d - Angle_e_a_f + pi/2
8. Perpendicular(a,c,b,d) => Angle_a_c_d + Angle_b_d_c - pi/2
9. Perpendicular(a,c,a,f) & Perpendicular(a,c,b,d) => Parallel(a,f,b,d)
10. Parallel(a,f,b,d) => Angle_a_d_b + Angle_d_a_f - pi
11. Angle_a_c_d - Angle_a_e_d & Angle_a_d_b - Angle_c_a_d & Angle_c_a_f - pi/2 & Angle_a_e_d - Angle_e_a_f + pi/2 & Angle_a_c_d - Angle_b_d_c & Angle_a_c_d + Angle_b_d_c - pi/2 & Angle_c_a_d + Angle_c_a_f - Angle_d_a_f & Angle_a_d_b + Angle_d_a_f - pi => Angle_d_a_f - Angle_e_a_f
12. Length_a_d - Length_a_e & Angle_d_a_f - Angle_e_a_f => Congruent3(a,d,f,a,e,f)
13. Congruent3(a,d,f,a,e,f) => Angle_a_d_f - Angle_a_e_f
